title: Unit Event — On the Stage of Dazzling Light — Episode2 A Pianist Named Thorpe

meta.Event: On the Stage of Dazzling Light
meta.Event Outline: Ever since his visit to Riley Dream Park, Tsukasa has felt a desire to improve even more as an actor. In the troupe's new ambassadorial show, he takes on a character unlike any he has before, with a personality entirely opposite his own.

rows.Line: Wonderland SEKAI

rows.Speaker: Narrator
rows.Line: “A long time ago, in a certain town, there was a pianist named Thorpe.”

rows.Speaker: Narrator
rows.Line: “Thorpe was a gifted pianist who lived on the outskirts of his town, and you could always hear the melodious sounds of a piano emanating from his place of lodging.”

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line:
Oh wow...!
Tsukasa's so good at playing the piano!

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line:
Yes, he is!
I'd heard that he could play, but not this well.

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line:
Rui! Rui!
Doesn't this make Tsukasa a perfect fit for Thorpe?

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line:
Yes...
He certainly won't have any problems when it comes to playing the piano...

rows.Speaker: Narrator
rows.Line: “But Thorpe had a rather grave failing. Whenever he tried to perform in front of others, he wasn't able to play to the best of his abilities...”

rows.Speaker: Narrator
rows.Line: “Thorpe would audition for his town's band many times, but fail every time due to not being able to perform when it matters most.”

rows.Speaker: Narrator
rows.Line: “Having nowhere else to go, Thorpe began playing the piano at a local tavern that was so run down that it hardly ever received any visitors. A place where no one would hear him play.”

rows.Speaker: Thorpe
rows.Line:
“*Sigh*
If only I could join a big band and play music with them...”

rows.Speaker: Thorpe
rows.Line: “I know. In times like this, it's always nice to look at the stars...”

rows.Speaker: Thorpe
rows.Line: “They're so beautiful...”

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: (Thorpe looks up towards the stars because he feels stuck in terms of achieving his goals... He seems to have trouble facing reality because he lacks initiative...)

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line:
(I see...
So this is what Rui was worried about.)

rows.Speaker: Narrator
rows.Line: “As Thorpe sits and stares at the distant stars...”

rows.Speaker: Bandleader
rows.Line:
“Well, if it isn't Thorpe.
Is this where you're playing your piano these days?”

rows.Speaker: Thorpe
rows.Line: “Wait, you're the leader of that band...! It's been so long. What are you doing in a place like this?”

rows.Speaker: Bandleader
rows.Line: “Some of the band and I are here to have some drinks... I see that your love for playing the piano hasn't faded.”

rows.Speaker: Thorpe
rows.Line:
“No, it hasn't...
But I'm still not able to perform when it really counts...”

rows.Speaker: Bandleader
rows.Line: “You'd be more than welcome to play in my band if only you managed to overcome that... Oh, I know!”

rows.Speaker: Bandleader
rows.Line: “A big contest is going to be taking place in town soon. Why don't you enter into it?”

rows.Speaker: Thorpe
rows.Line: “Huh?”

rows.Speaker: Bandleader
rows.Line: “Wouldn't playing in front of a big crowd like that give you a big boost of courage? If you manage to win, my band may be willing to welcome you in as a new member.”

rows.Speaker: Bandleader
rows.Line: “Anyway, we'll be looking forward to your performance.”

rows.Speaker: Thorpe
rows.Line: “If I win... I'll get to join them...?”

rows.Speaker: Thorpe
rows.Line: “I'm probably never going to get another chance to join a band like this again... I have to enter!”

rows.Speaker: Narrator
rows.Line: “Thorpe began practicing like there was no tomorrow.”

rows.Speaker: Narrator
rows.Line: “However, no matter how much he practiced, Thorpe still couldn't play well even during his mock rehearsal in front of the others boarding with him.”

rows.Speaker: Narrator
rows.Line: “With only ten days left until the contest, an absolutely exhausted Thorpe received some special visitors.”

rows.Speaker: Big Sister Squirrel
rows.Line: “That piano sounds so wonderful♪”

rows.Speaker: Little Sister Squirrel
rows.Line: “Yes, it really does!”

rows.Speaker: Thorpe
rows.Line: “Huh? Squirrels...?”

rows.Speaker: Big Sister Squirrel
rows.Line:
“Hey, Mr. Pianist!
Can you play a song for us?”

rows.Speaker: Little Sister Squirrel
rows.Line: “We want to learn how to dance to a song for this party we'll be attending soon.”

rows.Speaker: Narrator
rows.Line: “A pair of squirrel sisters from a nearby forest had come to visit. As cute as they were, to Thorpe, they only got in the way of him practicing.”

rows.Speaker: Thorpe
rows.Line:
“I don't care about your party!
I'm busy! Leave me alone!”

rows.Speaker: Big Sister Squirrel
rows.Line: “Please, just one song!”

rows.Speaker: Little Sister Squirrel
rows.Line: “We really want you to play it for us!”

rows.Speaker: Thorpe
rows.Line:
“Ugh... Fine, I'll play it!
But you need to go after it's over.”

rows.Speaker: Big Sister Squirrel
rows.Line:
“Oh wow! This is a great song!
But don't you think you're playing a bit too fast?”

rows.Speaker: Little Sister Squirrel
rows.Line:
“Yeah, she's right!
We'd have to dance and twirl so fast just to keep up!”

rows.Speaker: Thorpe
rows.Line:
“Enough!
If all you're going to do is complain, I'm not going to play for you!”

rows.Speaker: Narrator
rows.Line: “The squirrels danced and twirled as best they could, but before they went home, they asked Thorpe to slow things down next time.”

rows.Speaker: Narrator
rows.Line:
“Thorpe let out a deep sigh.
However, to his dismay, the squirrels had told their animal friends about him and they all came to visit the next day.”

rows.Speaker: Sheep
rows.Line:
“Hello, Mr. Pianist.
Can you play a nice song that'll help me and my friends from the farm fall asleep?”

rows.Speaker: Migrating Bird
rows.Line: “Mr. Pianist! I got separated from my friends! Can you play a fun song that'll let them know that I'm here?”

rows.Speaker: Big Brother Cat
rows.Line: “Mr. Pianist, my little brother and sister are sick. Can you play a song that'll make them feel better?”

rows.Speaker: Little Brother Cat
rows.Line:
“*Sob*
My tummy hurts...”

rows.Speaker: Little Sister Cat
rows.Line:
“*Sob*
My head hurts...”

rows.Speaker: Thorpe
rows.Line:
“Alright, fine...!
But in return, you have to leave after I'm done playing!”

rows.Speaker: Thorpe
rows.Line: “They're finally gone. I can practice in peace now...”

rows.Speaker: Thorpe
rows.Line: “But there might not be any point now since the contest is tomorrow.”

rows.Speaker: Thorpe
rows.Line:
“*Sigh*
I only have half a day left...”

rows.Speaker: Thorpe
rows.Line: “The stars... They're so beautiful...”

rows.Speaker: Narrator
rows.Line: “And so, the day of the contest had arrived.”

rows.Speaker: Narrator
rows.Line: “Thorpe was worried sick about not getting to rehearse in front of others, but he desperately played as best he could. As a result...”

rows.Speaker: Bandleader
rows.Line: “That was magnificent, Thorpe!”

rows.Speaker: Bandleader
rows.Line: “How did you practice to get this good? Could it be that you found someone to listen to you play?”

rows.Speaker: Thorpe
rows.Line: “*Gasp*”

rows.Speaker: Narrator
rows.Line: “That's right. Thorpe learned how to play in front of others because his animal friends came to listen each day.”

rows.Speaker: Narrator
rows.Line: “As the crowd called for an encore, Thorpe decided to play his favorite song to thank all the animals for what they did.”

rows.Speaker: Narrator
rows.Line: “Outside of the venue, the animals heard his performance and nodded in thanks for giving them another wonderful song... The end.”

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: Is about how it goes...

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line:
So many animals!
That sounds like a lot of fun♪

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line:
Alright, Rui!
What did you think of my performance? I personally thought there was nothing wrong!

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line:
Especially when I played the piano!
It should be smooth sailing with me at the helm!

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Yeah, Tsukasa, seeing you on the piano was so cool! Especially when you went all ba-da-da-da-dum!

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: Yeah, despite everything that was said beforehand, you'll probably be fine with a bit of practice...

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line:
No...
We shouldn't be so hasty.

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: What?! Why?!

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: I agree that there was nothing seriously wrong on the surface, but...

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: You're just not fit for this role, Tsukasa...

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Not fit...?
